in_sanskrit.name: चिन्तु
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Chintu is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘चिन्तन’ (chintana), which means ‘thinking, contemplating, reflecting, or meditating’. The name is often used as a pet name or a nickname for a child who is intelligent, thoughtful, or deep in thought.

in_hindi.name: चिन्तु
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Chintu is derived from the Hindi words ‘चिन्ता’ (chintā) meaning ‘thought, consideration, or reflection’, and ‘ू’ (ū) which is a suffix used to form diminutives or pet names. Therefore, Chintu can be translated to ‘one who has deep thoughts or contemplates much’.

in_tamil.name: சிந்து
in_tamil.long_meaning: The name Chintu in Tamil is derived from the word ‘சிந்தனம்’ (chintanam), which means ‘thinking, contemplation, or meditation’. This name is often used as a pet name or a nickname for a child who is intelligent, thoughtful, or deep in thought.

in_telugu.name: చిన్టు
in_telugu.long_meaning: The name Chintu in Telugu is derived from the word ‘చిన్తనము’ (chintanamu), which means ‘thinking, contemplation, or meditation’. This name is often used as a pet name or a nickname for a child who is intelligent, thoughtful, or deep in thought.

in_marathi.name: Chintu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chintu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Chintu is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘chin’ which means ‘to think’ or ‘intelligence’. In Hindu mythology, Chintu is believed to be an embodiment of knowledge and wisdom.
